task.title: Change Your Unity Password
task.shortdesc: Change your NC State password through the university's self-service identity management system.

context.p: The NC State self-service password change process works identically for students, faculty, and staff. If you have forgotten your current password, use the "Reset Password" link on the self-service portal instead.

step.cmd: Navigate to the NC State Password Change Form at https://selfserviceidm.ncsu.edu/SSPW/pwdchangeform.htm.
Enter your Unity ID and your Current Password in the required fields.

Enter a New Password that is different from your current and previous passwords, excludes your Unity ID, contains no apostrophe (') or pipe (|), does not start or end with a space, and is 100 characters or fewer.
Confirm on screen that all seven password requirements pass and that the Strength indicator displays Strong.
Re-enter the password in the Confirm New Password field and submit the form to save your updated Unity credentials.
